description: [compact alias of delete_node] Removes a node and all its children from a scene. Use to clean up unused nodes. Cannot delete root node. Scene is saved automatically unless saveScene=false.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to project directory containing project.godot. Use the same path across all tool calls in a workflow.

saveScene.description: If true (default), saves scene after deletion. Set false for batch operations.

scenePath.description: Path to .tscn file relative to project (e.g., "scenes/Player.tscn")

name: scene-node-delete
